description.en: An invoice photo becomes a goods receipt: the owner's browser reads the photo with tesseract.js (sqi+eng, vendored under /lib/ocr, no network), the owner confirms each line, each confirmed line is written through the existing receipt door POST /api/owner/stock/received (qty in the supply's base unit, the invoice total in whole lek, supplier, invoice number), and the line-text -> supply matches are remembered on the supplier's card through POST /api/owner/stock/alias, so the next invoice from that supplier arrives matched. The OCR is client-side; this contract covers the requests built from it and the read-back on GET /api/owner/stock.
description.uk: Фото накладної стає прийманням товару: браузер власника читає фото (tesseract.js, sqi+eng, локально), власник підтверджує кожен рядок, рядки пишуться через наявний POST /api/owner/stock/received, а відповідності назв запамʼятовуються на картці постачальника (POST /api/owner/stock/alias).

external_api_version: tesseract.js 7.0.0 / tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 / tessdata_best_int 4.0.0 (sqi, eng) -- client-side only, no remote API

qty.description: base unit of the supply: g, ml or pieces

total.description: the invoice line amount, whole lek

text.description: the line's words, numbers dropped; stored lower-cased, single-spaced

item.description: supply id, or empty to forget the alias

errors.400: body not {card}, unknown field (strict), a line's words empty or over 120 characters, more than 100 lines, a NIPT that is not letter+8 digits+letter, over 500 aliases for one supplier
errors.404: no supplier card with that id, or a supply id that does not exist
errors.401/403: not the venue's owner or staff

personal_data: none: line text is a product name as printed, item a supply id, the NIPT a business's public tax number; the card's contact person stays on the card (registry/venue.rs, image stock)
limits: OCR accuracy is measured on SYNTHETIC images only (tools/live-proof/fixtures/receipt); real phone photos of real invoices are unmeasured.
